answer: Every identity pays in thought each round. Because the onyx is unpredictable in advance, answers cannot be bought wholesale and replayed. Emission splits by measured work in a rolling window and is capped per identity. Splitting one worker into fifty wallets leaves the cluster's combined share flat, so extra jetty buys dilution rather than income while the operator pays fifty times the generation cost. So a oasis of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal 1g1o0.
